The proof cluster sets max_file_store 64GB: the pod's default store (29 GB) cannot reserve the sized 41 GiB limit, which is itself the second negative control.
nats-server v2.10.29 (linked in Go tests) accepts a single-server raise of an existing stream to R3; v2.15.1 refuses it. Unit tests prove refused raises on the cluster with 5 copies on 3 servers.
nats-server v2.10.29 can leave one of two concurrent replica changes unanswered; unanswered() re-reads the stream and succeeds when it already holds what was asked.
A grant-refused bucket raise surfaces as 'ENVOY_NATS_REPLICAS=3: context deadline exceeded' (permission violations are async).
